title: Two special tools and many blocks
description: Add stairs: half blocks and special tools for diamonds, audio, and iron.
body:
I've added Slabs and Stairs for materials that were previously lacking them: Diamond, Iron, and Obsidian.

Also, this mod features two powerful Admin Tools:

Admin Pickaxe: Right-click to instantly break blocks in a 16x16 area.

Admin Knife: Right-click to transform surrounding Stone into Glass.

Note: For technical reference, the Admin tools are registered with the Item ID format: magic_[tool_name].
